title: Restore required main status-check contexts
purpose: Restore the exact four-context main protection contract without weakening the ruleset by emitting compatibility check contexts for the two existing authoritative repository-validation jobs.
invariants: The main-protection ruleset is not edited or weakened.
The existing validate-repository and gate jobs remain the authoritative validations.
Repository governance compatibility context succeeds only when validate-repository succeeds.
PR scope compatibility context succeeds only when gate succeeds.
Only the three exact allowed paths may change.
No Gate 0, Gate 1, product, Atlas, authoring, kit, Pages, release or runtime behavior changes.
PR #161 head remains byte-for-byte untouched by this work package.
requiredEvidence: Changed paths equal the three-path allowlist.
Repository governance workflow emits both validate-repository and Repository governance and both are green.
PR scope workflow emits both gate and PR scope and both are green.
The repository ruleset remains unchanged and still requires all four contexts.
PR scope validation passes on the exact maintenance head.
adversarialTests: If validate-repository fails or is cancelled, Repository governance compatibility context must fail.
If gate fails or is cancelled, PR scope compatibility context must fail.
No compatibility job can bypass or replace its upstream authoritative job.
A fourth changed path fails scope validation.
nonGoals: Repairing the unrelated Learn-it Next CI branch router.
Changing product behavior or release artifacts.
independentReview: One exact-head scope and workflow semantics review is sufficient because the change adds no production behavior and does not weaken protection.
rollback: Revert merge commit 286fa0cbd487c25862a2826a4de54ca8eac9e7b6 to remove the compatibility contexts. The main-protection ruleset itself was not modified.
